Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Account.name: Account
Account.comment:
An account an agent runs on (D104): forty questions an hour and a million
tokens over any day, each charged to its workspace too. The provider's own
count of its tokens, read every few minutes, replaces what the account
counted until the provider's period rolls over (observe, for callers who
hold accounts.observe). Usage that takes it past a cap moves it out, until
a person moves it back.

Job.name: Job
Job.comment:
A job a worker takes (D104). The worker leases it with a fencing token and
presents the token with every write while it holds it, so a process whose
lease lapsed cannot write after another took the job. A lease the worker
stops renewing expires when its deadline falls due and moves the job back
to queued; the third expiry fails it. A timeout waits a minute before the
job runs again, twice as long after each next one up to ten minutes, and
then moves it from waiting back to queued; a build failure is retried once
per revision; a job that has failed for half an hour gives up; and at most
four attempts start in an hour. Its revision is not named version, which a
table that composes behaviors keeps its own version in (_version).

fields.name: leaseHolder
fields.description: The subject of the principal that holds the lease; absent when the instance is free.

fields.name: leaseToken
fields.description: The fencing token. It advances at every acquire, release and expiry, and a write under the lease presents it.

fields.name: leaseAcquiredAt
fields.description: When the lease was acquired, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

fields.name: leaseRenewedAt
fields.description: Its acquire or its last heartbeat, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

fields.name: leaseExpiresAt
fields.description: When the lease expires unless it is renewed, in epoch milliseconds; absent when the instance is free.

fields.name: leaseExpiries
fields.description: How many leases have expired or been abandoned since the last resetExpiries.

fields.name: leaseEnded
fields.description: How and when the last lease ended (reason and at); absent while one is held.

fields.name: retriesTotal
fields.description: Failures counted.

fields.name: retriesClassAttempts
fields.description: Failures counted, by failure class.

fields.name: retriesBestScore
fields.description: The score of the kept result; absent when no scored result is kept.

fields.name: retriesExhausted
fields.description: Whether the instance has run out of attempts.

fields.name: retriesStuck
fields.description: Whether the instance failed with the same signature stuckAfter times in a row.

fields.name: retriesRetryAt
fields.description: When the row may run again after its last failure, in epoch milliseconds, as its class's backoff gives it; absent when it may run at once. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

fields.name: retriesFailingSince
fields.description: When the first failure since the row's last success was recorded, in epoch milliseconds, which giveUpAfterMs counts from; absent after a success, and without giveUpAfterMs. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

fields.name: retriesKeyedBy
fields.description: The value of keyField the counts were made under, as text; absent without keyField. A table's alone: an engine type keeps none.

fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

JobDeadline.name: JobDeadline
JobDeadline.comment: The deadlines Job's behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Job row the deadline is armed on.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that armed it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name, the use's own.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was armed to fall due, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the use armed it with, which its deadline hook reads.

JobLeaseDirectives.name: JobLeaseDirectives
JobLeaseDirectives.comment: One row per directive sent to the holder of the row's lease, keyed by its number in the lease: the token it was sent under, what it asks, its data, the dedupeKey it was sent with, who sent it and when, and when the holder acknowledged it. Every end of a lease deletes its directives, so none reaches the next holder.

fields.name: job
fields.description: The Job row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The directive's number in its lease, from 1 in the order they were sent, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: token
fields.description: The lease's token it was sent under.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the directive asks.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Its data.

fields.name: dedupeKey
fields.description: The key it was sent with, when it was.

fields.name: sentBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller who sent it, or of the principal a behavior's call ran for.

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: When it was sent, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: acknowledgedAt
fields.description: When the holder acknowledged it; absent while heartbeats deliver it.

JobRetriesAttempts.name: JobRetriesAttempts
JobRetriesAttempts.comment: One row per attempt the row recorded, keyed by its number, the order they were recorded in: when, its failure class (absent for a success), its score, whether its result was kept, its signature, its predicates and its detail, who recorded it, and the keyField value it counted under. The window, stuckAfter's streak, keepBest's neverRegress and a backoff's wait read it.

fields.name: job
fields.description: The Job row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The attempt's number on the row, from 1 in the order they were recorded, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was recorded, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: failure
fields.description: Its failure class; absent for a success.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Its score; absent when it gave none.

fields.name: kept
fields.description: Whether its result was kept.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: What identified its failure, for stuckAfter.

fields.name: predicates
fields.description: The named checks it passed or failed, for keepBest's neverRegress.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: What recordAttempt was told about it, as it was given.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of the caller who recorded it.

fields.name: keyedBy
fields.description: The value of keyField it counted under, as text; absent without keyField.

Session.name: Session
Session.comment:
A session a device opens for an agent (D104). Only the device's principal
beats it, and it stays live three minutes after its last beat, and fifteen
while its agent is in a turn, counted from the later of the beat and the
turn's start. A session not beaten in time is missed: it moves to missing,
and the leases its device holds on jobs are expired, but for one the device
renewed since its last beat. Its next beat brings it back to idle.

fields.name: presenceDeadline
fields.description: When the instance is missed unless it is beaten, in epoch milliseconds: ttlMs after its create or its last beat; absent on an instance made before the schema composed Presence, until its first beat.

fields.name: presenceLastBeatAt
fields.description: When the instance was last beaten, in epoch milliseconds; absent before the first beat.

fields.name: presenceMissed
fields.description: Whether the instance missed its deadline and has not been beaten since.

fields.name: presenceReleased
fields.description: The instances whose lease the last miss expired, by schema; absent before a miss.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.
